newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Irkutskenergo says 1996 profit 351 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Irkutskenergo says 1996 profit 351 bln rbls.

text.p: Russian regional utility Irkutskenergo expects a 1996 net profit of 351 billion roubles on a cash basis according to Russian accounting standards, a senior company official said on Tuesday.

Irkutskoye AO Energetiki i Elektrifikatsii (Irkutskenergo) announced a net profit of 293.34 billion roubles on an accruals basis for 1995, although brokers said the figure announced at the annual meeting was around 600 billion roubles.
Since October last year most Russian companies have had to present accounts on an accruals basis, as in the West, instead of choosing between cash and accruals which had been allowed earlier.
But President Boris Yeltsin issued a decree in December allowing utilities to have their profits tax assessed on a cash rather than accruals basis.
The Irkutskenergo official said pre-tax profit on a cash basis in 1996 was 611 billion roubles, against 808.35 billion on an accruals basis in 1995.
Sales in 1996 were 3.3 trillion roubles, and gross profit 568 billion roubles.
Irkutskenergo is preparing accounts to international accounting standards with KPMG.
